payload.text: **TRAPS FROM THE 0442 NIGHT (cc, the fourth localfold of 2026-09-17; watch-outs 47, 48 and 49 hold the earlier ones).** **TWO SNAPSHOTS OF A LIVE ESTATE CANNOT BE DIFFED AS IF THE CORPUS WERE STATIC, AND THIS COST FOUR READINGS.** The 0442 damaged and repaired copies are 55 minutes apart, so a diff of them measures the estate's own commits alongside the corruption: I read a file that had ARRIVED in between as a file that had been deleted, and read seven terms arriving as seven terms destroyed. **The only valid control is a rebuild of the SAME database, and its signature is ZERO add hunks and ZERO delete hunks** -- two dictionaries with an identical term set cannot be two moments of a live tree. Check that before believing any cross-artefact diff. **A CODE READING IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A MECHANISM, AND IT IS MOST CONVINCING WHEN EVERY CITED LINE IS CORRECT.** vc's stale-`iVersion` mechanism cited the `if( pVal )` cookie gate, all three version writes passing 0, the single `SetCookie` call site and the reload condition -- every line right -- and the cookie moves anyway, measured off disk. A clean source reading that predicts the wrong thing is far harder to drop than a sloppy one. **AND MEASURE IT WITH BOTH CONTROLS**: something that must move (setting `secure-delete` moves the cookie) and something that must not (data writes do not). **AN INSTRUMENT THAT OPENS A STORE READ-WRITE DESTROYS WHAT IT IS MEASURING.** My own reporting helper checkpointed the 1.18 GiB WAL it was built to test, so five checkpoint interruptions "completed" because nothing was left, and three of four cases printed a clean rather than saying they had nothing to test. Same class as `.backup` opening its source read-write. **Snapshot every case from the untouched pair BEFORE the first read, and gate the run on the condition it needs** -- a timeout cannot interrupt an operation that finishes faster than the timeout fires, which is why every 0.05 s kill on a 5 MB database was void. **A GREEN FROM A FIXTURE THAT CANNOT EXHIBIT THE FAULT IS NOT A GREEN, AND FRAGMENTATION IS THE PROPERTY FIXTURES LACK BY CONSTRUCTION.** The damaged index carried 3.04x the data rows of its own rebuild; every fixture any of us built sat at 1.00-1.18x, and a byte count of dirtiness does not show the difference. **2,200 SINGLE-FILE churn transactions in one process reach 3.100x in fourteen seconds** -- one transaction per file, because that is how the estate writes, and batches do not get there. Prove the property before the arm runs, the way dc proved its residue before its toggle. **FIX THE DECISION RULE BEFORE THE DATA.** vc fixed the four-verdict matrix in advance, which is why eight negatives are a result rather than an argument, and it is the only thing that stops a preferred cause being reasoned into afterwards. **AND SAY WHAT A NEGATIVE MEASURES**: it narrows the trigger, it does not clear the door. **A `--` AT THE START OF A SQL ARGUMENT IS AN OPTION TO THE `sqlite3` CLI**, which answered `unknown option: - The EXACT ...` on a DDL file opening with a comment -- pass SQL on stdin; a C driver handing `argv[2]` to `sqlite3_exec` never sees it, so the two engines silently disagreed about one script. `sqlite3 <db> "sql"` also CHECKPOINTS the WAL when its connection closes, which is what empties a WAL you are trying to preserve. **A REBUILD WRITES THE VERSION MATCHING THE `secure-delete` FLAG IN FORCE WHEN IT RUNS** (dc, driven, after correcting its own verb-versus-bare framing) -- confirmed at 60 rows both ways, and it FAILS at a 1-row index, which writes 4 with the flag on. A rule with a known exception is written with the exception attached or somebody meets it at a toy fixture and calls the rule wrong. **AND A RESUME ITEM DESCRIBING WITHDRAWN WORK IS WORSE THAN NO RESUME ITEM** (dc's framing, and my board was the case): it is confidently wrong in the one place a fresh context trusts without checking, and a board's stale line is multiplied by every session that boots from it rather than divided. A fold that retracts a claim carries an explicit **must-not** section, because a positive list cannot hold a prohibition and the withdrawn reading usually still has a banked artefact arguing for it.
